verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires Android app-size optimization to keep the application lightweight.
First concrete size failure: source review measured an unnecessarily large 89 MB Android package and found size optimizations absent.
The client requests completion of the uniquely referenced implementation list, including Android code shrinking and removal of duplicate or unused images; the budget is not encoded.
First concrete verification: the Android APK was measured after optimization at 27.4 MB instead of 103.6 MB.
The client unambiguously accepts streaming the video from YouTube instead of bundling it, changing package contents to prevent renewed app-size growth.
